Transcription of a silent or empty audio file returns empty text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateTranscriptionRequest;
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->transcribe(new \Liter\Llm\CreateTranscriptionRequest(model: "whisper-1",
file: "silence.mp3"));
var_dump($result->text);
```
